verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes one processing clock: e-file provider applications can take "up to 45 days" to approve (irs-supp-6). That is a static maximum for one niche transaction, not a current, live figure. No processing times are evidenced for core founder transactions such as EIN applications by mail or fax, or 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: current or live processing-time figures, published times for EIN (SS-4 mail/fax) and Form 15620/83(b) processing, coverage across founder transaction types.
